title: StockSmart Bin Coverage of VendPoint Substitute Items — Inventory Coordination Table
content:
Inventory coordination between the VendPoint Industrial Vending Program and the StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program for the par of a substitute Corbett places in a retired item's selection.

The storeroom backup factor follows the StockSmart program whose status is active at the machine's ship-to: when that program carries a bin for the substitute, meaning its new-bin entries for the substitute outnumber its bin removal entries for it, and the substitute's latest bin set entry on that program, the one carrying the highest bin request reference, is flagged critical, the factor is the critical-bin backup factor; when that program carries a bin for the substitute and that entry is not flagged critical, the factor is the plain-bin backup factor; otherwise the factor is one.

| StockSmart program active at the ship-to | Bin carried for the substitute | Latest bin set entry flagged critical | Backup factor |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Yes | 0.7 (critical-bin backup factor) |
| Yes | Yes | No | 0.85 (plain-bin backup factor) |
| Yes | No | not applicable | 1 |
| No | not applicable | not applicable | 1 |

A bin is carried when the program's new-bin entries for the substitute outnumber its bin removal entries for it: hypothetically, three new-bin entries against two removal entries carry a bin, two against two do not.
